test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

BARRIER
solution:
The correct answer is '**Opening**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Barrier**' is '**Opening**'.
 
• **Barrier**: an object that keeps people or things separate or prevents them moving from one place to another. (लोगों या वस्‍तुओं के आने-जाने को रोकने या एक दूसरे से अलग करने वाली अवरोधक वस्‍तु; बैरियर)
 
 
• *Example: The crowd were all kept behind **barriers**.*
 
 
 
• **Opening**: a space or hole that somebody/something can go through. [छेद या सुराख़ (जिसमें से कोई या कुछ जा सके)]
 
 
• *Example: We were able to get through an **opening** in the hedge.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Opening.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Advocate**: to recommend or say that you support a particular plan or action. [(किसी योजना या कार्रवाही का) समर्थन करना; सिफ़ारिश करना]
 
• **Obstacle**: something that makes it difficult for you to do something or go somewhere. (बाधा, अड़चन, अवरोध)
 
• **Hindrance**: a person or thing that makes it difficult for you to do something, an obstacle or obstruction. (किसी काम में कठिनाई पैदा करने वाला व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु, बाधक तत्‍व; रुकावट, बाधा, विघ्‍न)
